meta.title: Impermanence
meta.description: Until the play concludes, you can never be sure of what grotesque conclusion the director has planned.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers stop firing.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers stop firing.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers stop firing.

units.rawText: As the smoke clears, densely-packed Entropic corpses can be seen floating on the ocean's surface.
units.displayText: As the smoke clears, densely-packed Entropic corpses can be seen floating on the ocean's surface.

spans.text: As the smoke clears, densely-packed Entropic corpses can be seen floating on the ocean's surface.

units.rawText: Demiurge, who was controlling them, stands in stark solitude amidst this sea of Entropy.
units.displayText: Demiurge, who was controlling them, stands in stark solitude amidst this sea of Entropy.

spans.text: Demiurge, who was controlling them, stands in stark solitude amidst this sea of Entropy.

units.rawText: ...Careful, she's still alive.
units.displayText: ...Careful, she's still alive.

spans.text: ...Careful, she's still alive.

units.rawText: She twitches her feelers and slowly props her body up. Her gaze is not turned to the weapons and guns trained on her, but at the sky above the Copley Sector.
units.displayText: She twitches her feelers and slowly props her body up. Her gaze is not turned to the weapons and guns trained on her, but at the sky above the Copley Sector.

spans.text: She twitches her feelers and slowly props her body up. Her gaze is not turned to the weapons and guns trained on her, but at the sky above the Copley Sector.

units.rawText: For the first time, sunlight shines directly on her face, not filtered through seawater or after passing through a fissure at the bottom of the sea.
units.displayText: For the first time, sunlight shines directly on her face, not filtered through seawater or after passing through a fissure at the bottom of the sea.

spans.text: For the first time, sunlight shines directly on her face, not filtered through seawater or after passing through a fissure at the bottom of the sea.

units.rawText: ...Freedom...
units.displayText: ...Freedom...

spans.text: ...Freedom...

units.rawText: She wades through the deep purple seawater, making her way toward the operand-simulated sunlight.
units.displayText: She wades through the deep purple seawater, making her way toward the operand-simulated sunlight.

spans.text: She wades through the deep purple seawater, making her way toward the operand-simulated sunlight.

units.rawText: No resistance detected from the target. Watch out for further actions from the Entropic unit. The special specimen must be captured for analysis.
units.displayText: No resistance detected from the target. Watch out for further actions from the Entropic unit. The special specimen must be captured for analysis.

spans.text: No resistance detected from the target. Watch out for further actions from the Entropic unit. The special specimen must be captured for analysis.

units.rawText: Love and her Sanctifiers carefully watch Demiurge's movements. She shuffles toward her final destination, creating ripples across the water.
units.displayText: Love and her Sanctifiers carefully watch Demiurge's movements. She shuffles toward her final destination, creating ripples across the water.

spans.text: Love and her Sanctifiers carefully watch Demiurge's movements. She shuffles toward her final destination, creating ripples across the water.

units.rawText: <color=orange>At last... I'm touching... the light...</color>
units.displayText: At last... I'm touching... the light...

spans.text: At last... I'm touching... the light...

units.rawText: She raises her feelers to the heavens, drinking in the unreal sunlight. Just as she is about to reach the core of its warmth—
units.displayText: She raises her feelers to the heavens, drinking in the unreal sunlight. Just as she is about to reach the core of its warmth—

spans.text: She raises her feelers to the heavens, drinking in the unreal sunlight. Just as she is about to reach the core of its warmth—

units.rawText: A lance of deep purple operands condensed into physical form pierces her body.
units.displayText: A lance of deep purple operands condensed into physical form pierces her body.

spans.text: A lance of deep purple operands condensed into physical form pierces her body.

units.rawText: Light shines through the wound in her body. She remains frozen in the act of reaching for the sunlight as her final whimper fades away like fragrance wafting through the air.
units.displayText: Light shines through the wound in her body. She remains frozen in the act of reaching for the sunlight as her final whimper fades away like fragrance wafting through the air.

spans.text: Light shines through the wound in her body. She remains frozen in the act of reaching for the sunlight as her final whimper fades away like fragrance wafting through the air.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, the owner of the deep purple operands flaps her black wings, having arrived above Demiurge at some point.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, the owner of the deep purple operands flaps her black wings, having arrived above Demiurge at some point.

spans.text: Meanwhile, the owner of the deep purple operands flaps her black wings, having arrived above Demiurge at some point.

units.rawText: Odile!! You... You actually attacked Demiurge!?
units.displayText: Odile!! You... You actually attacked Demiurge!?

spans.text: Odile!! You... You actually attacked Demiurge!?

units.rawText: Registered Entropic unit detected. Alert!
units.displayText: Registered Entropic unit detected. Alert!

spans.text: Registered Entropic unit detected. Alert!

units.rawText: Hehe...
units.displayText: Hehe...

spans.text: Hehe...

units.rawText: As if to mock Sol's angry shout, Odile lands lightly on Demiurge's ravaged body.
units.displayText: As if to mock Sol's angry shout, Odile lands lightly on Demiurge's ravaged body.

spans.text: As if to mock Sol's angry shout, Odile lands lightly on Demiurge's ravaged body.

units.rawText: Purple petals fall from the sky, kissing the dark-colored ocean.
units.displayText: Purple petals fall from the sky, kissing the dark-colored ocean.

spans.text: Purple petals fall from the sky, kissing the dark-colored ocean.

units.rawText: Oh, what a beautiful soul! When clinging to her dreams, she was like a butterfly's fluttering wings;
units.displayText: Oh, what a beautiful soul! When clinging to her dreams, she was like a butterfly's fluttering wings;

spans.text: Oh, what a beautiful soul! When clinging to her dreams, she was like a butterfly's fluttering wings;

units.rawText: But when the wings are broken, she returns to the form of a maggot, and none will praise her lost beauty.
units.displayText: But when the wings are broken, she returns to the form of a maggot, and none will praise her lost beauty.

spans.text: But when the wings are broken, she returns to the form of a maggot, and none will praise her lost beauty.

units.rawText: How precious is freedom? Is it worth facing blades, or weathering hails of lead and steel?
units.displayText: How precious is freedom? Is it worth facing blades, or weathering hails of lead and steel?

spans.text: How precious is freedom? Is it worth facing blades, or weathering hails of lead and steel?

units.rawText: Only the tardy sun will kiss her cheek, and so the song of freedom continues.
units.displayText: Only the tardy sun will kiss her cheek, and so the song of freedom continues.

spans.text: Only the tardy sun will kiss her cheek, and so the song of freedom continues.

units.rawText: You... What have you done...!
units.displayText: You... What have you done...!

spans.text: You... What have you done...!

units.rawText: Would you... Would you even kill your own master!?
units.displayText: Would you... Would you even kill your own master!?

spans.text: Would you... Would you even kill your own master!?

units.rawText: A skilled director ought to know exactly when to end a farce and give each character an appropriate ending.
units.displayText: A skilled director ought to know exactly when to end a farce and give each character an appropriate ending.

spans.text: A skilled director ought to know exactly when to end a farce and give each character an appropriate ending.

units.rawText: She went through so much pain and hardship to escape her underground prison. And you, who proclaim yourselves to be just, would have locked her into another gaol.
units.displayText: She went through so much pain and hardship to escape her underground prison. And you, who proclaim yourselves to be just, would have locked her into another gaol.

spans.text: She went through so much pain and hardship to escape her underground prison. And you, who proclaim yourselves to be just, would have locked her into another gaol.

units.rawText: Surely she would not have wanted that, no? Thus, I gave her her final freedom.
units.displayText: Surely she would not have wanted that, no? Thus, I gave her her final freedom.

spans.text: Surely she would not have wanted that, no? Thus, I gave her her final freedom.

units.rawText: Demiurge stops moving for good.
units.displayText: Demiurge stops moving for good.

spans.text: Demiurge stops moving for good.

units.rawText: Odile caresses her gently, as if admiring a sculpture of her own making.
units.displayText: Odile caresses her gently, as if admiring a sculpture of her own making.

spans.text: Odile caresses her gently, as if admiring a sculpture of her own making.

units.rawText: All is as the Master wishes...
units.displayText: All is as the Master wishes...

spans.text: All is as the Master wishes...

units.rawText: What nonsense are you spewing now!?
units.displayText: What nonsense are you spewing now!?

spans.text: What nonsense are you spewing now!?

units.rawText: Demiurge is supposed to be dead... So why doesn't she seem to be affected at all!?
units.displayText: Demiurge is supposed to be dead... So why doesn't she seem to be affected at all!?

spans.text: Demiurge is supposed to be dead... So why doesn't she seem to be affected at all!?

units.rawText: Oh? Dear heroes, surely you didn't think that pitiful princess was my Master?
units.displayText: Oh? Dear heroes, surely you didn't think that pitiful princess was my Master?

spans.text: Oh? Dear heroes, surely you didn't think that pitiful princess was my Master?

units.rawText: Don't tell me...?
units.displayText: Don't tell me...?

spans.text: Don't tell me...?

units.rawText: Oh, how disappointing.
units.displayText: Oh, how disappointing.

spans.text: Oh, how disappointing.

units.rawText: Though my Master is similarly confined, her vast intellect has always shone like the sun.
units.displayText: Though my Master is similarly confined, her vast intellect has always shone like the sun.

spans.text: Though my Master is similarly confined, her vast intellect has always shone like the sun.

units.rawText: In comparison, this clueless princess was nothing more than a child. See the havoc she wreaked with just the slightest instigation? How childish.
units.displayText: In comparison, this clueless princess was nothing more than a child. See the havoc she wreaked with just the slightest instigation? How childish.

spans.text: In comparison, this clueless princess was nothing more than a child. See the havoc she wreaked with just the slightest instigation? How childish.

units.rawText: Dammit, I should have known!
units.displayText: Dammit, I should have known!

spans.text: Dammit, I should have known!

units.rawText: Anna, what's Odile saying?
units.displayText: Anna, what's Odile saying?

spans.text: Anna, what's Odile saying?

units.rawText: Earlier, I sensed that Demiurge's Entropics were different from the ones we encountered in Pierides.
units.displayText: Earlier, I sensed that Demiurge's Entropics were different from the ones we encountered in Pierides.

spans.text: Earlier, I sensed that Demiurge's Entropics were different from the ones we encountered in Pierides.

units.rawText: At first I thought it was because they were from different Sectors...
units.displayText: At first I thought it was because they were from different Sectors...

spans.text: At first I thought it was because they were from different Sectors...

units.rawText: But now it looks like Odile is being controlled by another Demiurge—or another Entropic leader, to be exact.
units.displayText: But now it looks like Odile is being controlled by another Demiurge—or another Entropic leader, to be exact.

spans.text: But now it looks like Odile is being controlled by another Demiurge—or another Entropic leader, to be exact.

units.rawText: Wait a minute, Anna...
units.displayText: Wait a minute, Anna...

spans.text: Wait a minute, Anna...

units.rawText: If that's true, then Odile came here—
units.displayText: If that's true, then Odile came here—

spans.text: If that's true, then Odile came here—

units.rawText: Did Odile come here... to kill Demiurge?
units.displayText: Did Odile come here... to kill Demiurge?

spans.text: Did Odile come here... to kill Demiurge?

units.rawText: Hehe, only at the end do the actors understand the script.
units.displayText: Hehe, only at the end do the actors understand the script.

spans.text: Hehe, only at the end do the actors understand the script.

units.rawText: "If you free her from her cage, someone will naturally grant her death."
units.displayText: "If you free her from her cage, someone will naturally grant her death."

spans.text: "If you free her from her cage, someone will naturally grant her death."

units.rawText: There cannot be two queens in a hive. The Master does not permit betrayal.
units.displayText: There cannot be two queens in a hive. The Master does not permit betrayal.

spans.text: There cannot be two queens in a hive. The Master does not permit betrayal.

units.rawText: Who's behind you!?
units.displayText: Who's behind you!?

spans.text: Who's behind you!?

units.rawText: I don't need to tell you right now, because sooner or later, you will all bathe in her largesse.
units.displayText: I don't need to tell you right now, because sooner or later, you will all bathe in her largesse.

spans.text: I don't need to tell you right now, because sooner or later, you will all bathe in her largesse.

units.rawText: <size=50>...YOU BITCH!</size>
units.displayText: ...YOU BITCH!

spans.text: ...YOU BITCH!

units.rawText: You seem quite upset. Is something bothering you?
units.displayText: You seem quite upset. Is something bothering you?

spans.text: You seem quite upset. Is something bothering you?

units.rawText: That blue-haired Sanctifier, perhaps? Or is it this princess who's about to dissolve into the seawater?
units.displayText: That blue-haired Sanctifier, perhaps? Or is it this princess who's about to dissolve into the seawater?

spans.text: That blue-haired Sanctifier, perhaps? Or is it this princess who's about to dissolve into the seawater?

units.rawText: You'd better not mention her again.
units.displayText: You'd better not mention her again.

spans.text: You'd better not mention her again.

units.rawText: Oh my, your eyes burn with the desire for revenge, yet you are no longer as rash as before.
units.displayText: Oh my, your eyes burn with the desire for revenge, yet you are no longer as rash as before.

spans.text: Oh my, your eyes burn with the desire for revenge, yet you are no longer as rash as before.

units.rawText: Would Miss Wisdom be touched if she saw this?
units.displayText: Would Miss Wisdom be touched if she saw this?

spans.text: Would Miss Wisdom be touched if she saw this?

units.rawText: <size=50>YOU—</size>
units.displayText: YOU—

spans.text: YOU—

units.rawText: Patience. Look around you.
units.displayText: Patience. Look around you.

spans.text: Patience. Look around you.

units.rawText: These Entropics are far stronger than the incomplete entities commanded by that princess.
units.displayText: These Entropics are far stronger than the incomplete entities commanded by that princess.

spans.text: These Entropics are far stronger than the incomplete entities commanded by that princess.

units.rawText: Shall we enjoy this fight scene, then?
units.displayText: Shall we enjoy this fight scene, then?

spans.text: Shall we enjoy this fight scene, then?

units.rawText: Don't get cocky, Odile. It'll be your turn soon enough.
units.displayText: Don't get cocky, Odile. It'll be your turn soon enough.

spans.text: Don't get cocky, Odile. It'll be your turn soon enough.

units.rawText: Of course. A good director ought to watch the entire production and take a bow with the actors.
units.displayText: Of course. A good director ought to watch the entire production and take a bow with the actors.

spans.text: Of course. A good director ought to watch the entire production and take a bow with the actors.

units.rawText: O brave dragonslayers, take care that you do not perish along the way.
units.displayText: O brave dragonslayers, take care that you do not perish along the way.

spans.text: O brave dragonslayers, take care that you do not perish along the way.
